name: How long does an exterior painting project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior painting project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior painting project varies significantly based on factors like the size of your home, its architectural complexity, the extent of surface preparation required, and weather conditions. A typical single-story home might take 3-5 days, while larger or more intricate homes could take 1-2 weeks. We aim to work efficiently while maintaining high quality standards. During our initial consultation, we can provide a more precise timeline tailored to your specific project and keep you informed of progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior painting projects typically take 3-5 days for smaller homes and up to 1-2 weeks for larger, more complex ones, depending on prep work and weather.
